title: Geo fleet ops forecast & launch cadence Q3-Q4 2026
content:
Purpose: quick-turn planning sheet for week-by-week capacity ramps and soft-launch windows across NA / EU / APAC. Use this to align infra, SRE, and sales for regional availability and expected utilization. Treat as a working spreadsheet - lots of TODOs and questions inline.

Top-level summary:
- Goal: hit baseline serving capacity for Hosted API across NA/EU/APAC with predictable tail latency < 120ms p50 for standard gen, and < 250ms p99 degraded during bursts.
- Timebox: Q3 ramp (Jul-Sep 2026) for NA/EU; Q4 (Oct-Dec 2026) full APAC launch cadence and buffering.
- Safety buffer: 12% reserved capacity (burst credits) per region until Q1 2027, then re-evaluate.

Assumptions & notes to reviewer:
- Demand forecast derived from quarter-to-date growth + 35% at-most-likely surge factor for PLG promotions. If growth > 50% month-over-month, schedule emergency provisioning (see runbook INF-ER).
- GPU types targeted: H100 (base), L40s for embeddings-only pools, and a small A100 pool for legacy models.
- Cloud distribution targeted for resiliency: NA primary on GCP (us-west1/us-central1), EU split across GCP/Azure (europe-west1/westeurope), APAC primarily on AWS + private-dedicated host options for enterprise customers.
- Cost target: keep effective $/token < current baseline by 5% through batching + KV caching enhancements.

Week-by-week rollout calendar (high level, by sprint week):
- W1 Jul: NA soft-expose - enable new routing policy for non-critical tenants -> metric: tail latency p99 for non-critical buckets <= 220ms. Owners: Ravi (routing), Morgan (SRE).
- W3 Jul: NA capacity bump + KV cache warmup window. Gate: cache hit-rate >= 45% for gen workloads. Action: enable cache-prefetch for top 100 prompts. Owner: Kai.
- W1 Aug: EU pilot region (GCP) - mirror NA config, limited to 20 enterprise customers. Gate: replica sync < 3s. Owners: Sofia + infra-oncall.
- W4 Aug: Cross-region fallback testing (NA->EU and EU->NA), simulated 30% cross-zone failover. Action: run chaos test on staging + DR runbook walkthrough.
- Sep: NA scale-throughput (prepare for PLG marketing push). Increase L40s autopool for cheap embeddings.
- Oct: APAC phased bring-up: week 1 light capacity, week 3 expand serving to 50% planned baseline, week 5 enable full routing. Gate: infra-legal signoff for data residency + KMS keys.
- Nov-Dec: Buffer phases and commercial enterprise onboarding windows; add dedicated pools for 3 flagged enterprise accounts.

Dependency checklist (must-haves before each region GA):
- Network egress contracts confirmed with cloud providers (account rep + discount).
- KMS/HSM keys provisioned and integrated for private workloads.
- Observability: per-route trace sampling, token-level cost and latency dashboards live for region.
- Billing: invoices mapping to committed usage for Dedicated customers.

Risk matrix / mitigation quick notes:
- GPU spot interruption risk (APAC AWS): mitigate with warm standby instances and automated fallback to NA or private-dedicated. Owner: Morgan.
- Model perf regressions after quantization: holdback 10% traffic to unquantized variant and run eval suites nightly. Owner: Research OPS.
- Network cross-region throttles: implement progressive routing with gradual ramp (10% increments) and circuit-breaker if p99 latency > 2x baseline. Owner: Ravi.

Cost and billing notes (rough):
- Estimated incremental monthly infra cost at Dec-26 capacity: $1.2M (cloud compute + networking) before committed discounts.
- Expected offset via Reserved commit for NA (GCP) starting Sep 2026 -> reduce unit cost ~12% after 12-month commitment.

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Re-run capacity model with updated PLG funnel assumptions (ask Growth) - tag: INF-PLAN-Q2.
- [ ] Confirm APAC private-dedicated hardware vendor lead times (30-45 days?).
- [ ] Finalize burst credit allocation algorithm (per-tenant vs per-region).
- [ ] Fill in full per-day maintenance window calendar for Sep-Nov.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Ravi: finalize routing policy config templates by 2026-06-15.
- Morgan: create chaos test plan + schedule for Aug cross-region test by 2026-07-10.
- Kai: cache warmup scripts and prefetch list by 2026-07-20.
- Sofia: legal & compliance checklist for APAC by 2026-09-01.

Appendix (quick model of conversion to concurrent sessions):
- Heuristic used: 1 H100 can sustain ~120 concurrent gen sessions (mixed prompt length), L40s ~350 embedding-only sessions. Values are conservative - we use 0.9 on-paper capacity for safety.
- If observed sessions per GPU > target_p95, schedule immediate scale + add 10% burst.

Notes to self (raw, keep):
- This sheet intentionally under-allocates on A100 - use only for legacy and troubleshooting.
- Consider a small pilot of LLM-optimized instances (vendor-specific silicon) if price points improve.
- Chat with Sales about soft GA messaging windows - want to avoid big bursts in first 2 weeks after region GA.

References: Confluence plan (linked), infra ticket INF-4237 (routing policy), PR #2194 (batching changes).
